name: John
text: the bins didnt go out last nite coz the lorry came early, i rang the depot n theyre booked for friday, John

name: Boufidis
text: the fire drill went ok but nobody checked the back stair door, ive emailed the warden, the alarm panel still shows a fault so thats logged, tell Boufidis b4 friday, its all in the book

name: Nilaja Ayomide
text: the raffle tix are printed n in the office, the top prize is a hamper this year, i need the seller sheets back b4 thursday so we can count, cake stall is full but we still need cups n a jug, Nilaja Ayomide will do the door

name: Dzeva Schnederle Viollet
text: the leccy bill went up again n the meter guy is coming tues, dont use the dryer this week, Dzeva Schnederle Viollet

name: Fayek
text: swimming lessons are cancelled tonite coz the heater is bust, ive asked for a refund for the block n the pool say it will land next week, Fayek has the forms, keep the kids posted

name: Izair
text: the boiler in the flat above is leaking into our ceiling n the landlord has been told twice, ive got photos of the stain getting bigger, plumber cant come till next week, there is a bucket out already, pls chase Izair for the report ref so we can claim

name: Coquis Chevallaz
text: the tombola prizes r in my boot, can someone grab the table from the shed, the tins are with Coquis Chevallaz

name: Delcy Pragana Brou
text: the choir coach is leaving at 5 not 6 on sat, there was a mix up with the times n a few ppl nearly missed it last year, i told Delcy Pragana Brou to put it in the group

name: Áaron
text: the hall booking for the panto is short by an hour coz the christmas fair has it first, the stage lights n the mics need checking b4 the dress run, the props r already in the store n the paint is in the back room, Áaron brings the ladder

name: Koppmeier
text: the keys for the kit cupboard r missing again, pls grab the shirts for tmora n check the padlock, the spare set is with Koppmeier

name: involved parties
text: the gate got left open again on sunday n the sheep got into the veg patch, the latch is bent so it doesnt catch, photos r in the group, pls tell the involved parties b4 the weekend

name: Caly Aferdita
text: the works do starts on monday n the crew will need the gate code, the skip goes on the drive so move the bins round the side, the water gets shut off tues morning for an hour, pls leave a note for the tenants, the kettle n mugs r in the van so warn Caly Aferdita at the shop

name: Aaruth
text: The loading bay was swept and the pallet stack was squared away. The roller shutter was serviced and the remote tested, as recorded by Aaruth.

name: Blanc
text: The delivery note was checked against the crate list and the shortfall was raised with the supplier. The damaged panel was photographed and set aside for collection. The goods in book was updated before the shift end, as noted by Blanc.

name: Bierbaum Varghese
text: The alarm tests were completed on all zones and the log was stamped. The faulty sensor in the east corridor was swapped and the panel rearmed. The contractor escorted the visitor off site at four and the keys were returned to the cabinet. The overnight team was briefed before handover, as confirmed by Bierbaum Varghese.

name: Kagitha Koncz Baltaian
text: The soil samples were posted to the lab and the results sheet was started. The drill was cleaned and stored, as logged by Kagitha Koncz Baltaian.

name: Ranim
text: The laundry returns were sorted and the missing items were listed for the contractor. The trolleys were steam cleaned and the shelf covers were replaced. The linen room was locked and the key was returned to the desk, per the notes from Ranim.

name: Laubscher
text: The borehole readings were taken and filed against the permit conditions. The flow meter was recalibrated after the drift alert and the certificate was scanned to the folder. The sample bottles were delivered to the lab and the chain of custody was signed at reception. The site diary was closed with no outstanding actions, as recorded by Laubscher.

name: Dzevdije Nergez
text: The meter reading was taken at the boundary and the photo was uploaded. The lid was sealed and tagged, as noted by Dzevdije Nergez.

name: Chongyu Gorjat
text: The fuel logs were tallied and the discrepancy on pump three was flagged to the depot. The nozzles were replaced and the drip trays were emptied. The tank gauge was photographed for the records, as verified by Chongyu Gorjat.

name: Hannu
text: The herd count was completed at first light and the ear tags were recorded. The water troughs were checked and one float valve was replaced. The fence line by the ford was walked and the broken posts were marked on the map. The gate springs were tensioned and the wayleave note was filed, as logged by Hannu.

name: Borko
text: The chiller alarm was tested and the calibration sticker was renewed. The door seals were wiped and the drain was flushed, as recorded by Borko.

name: Abdilbari Iljcho
text: The bolt torques on the gantry were rechecked and the second pass was witnessed. The lifting slings were inspected and one was withdrawn from service with a red tag. The inspection sheet was countersigned at the desk, as noted by Abdilbari Iljcho.

name: Travelletti Nizzola Beereuter
text: The abstract list was checked against the catalogue and two entries were corrected. The reading room cameras were tested and the footage was backed up to the archive. The late returns were processed and the fines were waived. The enquiry emails were answered and the referral forms were posted out, as logged by Travelletti Nizzola Beereuter.

name: Maleia
text:
the oven in the hall wont heat up n the fete is sat, can we borrow the big one from the scout hut, pls say yes b4 thurs, thanks,
Maleia

name: Damyanliev
text:
the minibus needs new wiper blades n the mot is in 2 weeks, i can drop it off monday if someones free to follow me back, could you book the slot tonite pls, thanks,
Damyanliev

name: Starchenko Kypke
text:
the stalls for the summer fair r nearly booked, we still need someone for the hook a duck n the coconut shy, the bouncy castle is confirmed n the band plays from 2, i put the layout in the shed for whoever sets up first, pls check the gazebo pegs b4 sat n bring the mallet, thanks,
Starchenko Kypke

name: Le Breton
text:
the paint for the railings is in the lock up, we need brushes n a scraper b4 sunday, is that ok, thanks,
Le Breton

name: Altin
text:
the trail ride is off coz the ford is too deep, we can do the shorter loop instead n skip the hill, pls put it in the group so nobody turns up at the usual spot, thanks,
Altin

name: Dikenmann
text:
the rehearsal room is double booked on weds so we r moving to the small hall, the piano needs tuning b4 the concert n the music stands r still in the van, i can bring the extension leads n lock up after, the caretaker has the key now, thanks,
Dikenmann

name: Ramakrishnan Helbach
text:
the labels for the jam jars r printed n in the kitchen drawer, we made 40 pots this year, thanks,
Ramakrishnan Helbach

name: Lia Cotone
text:
the tickets for the winter ball r selling ok but the table plan is a mess, i need the names by friday so the caterer can sort the seating, pls send any changes b4 the weekend, thanks,
Lia Cotone

name: Grace
text:
the leak in the porch has come back since the storm n the bucket fills overnight, the roofer cant get here till tues so we r moving the mat n the boots, pls keep the door shut n tell the neighbours, the drip tray is under the sill, thanks,
Grace

name: Gammuto
text:
the seed swap is back on for sunday, bring any spare packets n a pen for the labels, thanks,
Gammuto

name: Maksut Meïssan Elisei
text:
the deep clean rota for the changing rooms is up on the board, we need two more names for the weekend slots n the key is at the desk, pls write yours in b4 fridy, thanks,
Maksut Meïssan Elisei

name: Chaalia Qerimaj
text:
the charity quiz went brill n we raised 620 for the roof fund, the winners r collecting the vouchers from the cafe this week, i still have the answer sheets n the tin of pens to drop back, pls thank the bar staff for the free room, thanks,
Chaalia Qerimaj

name: Frenk
text:
the spare kits r in the loft above the garage, theyre washed n bagged, grab one b4 the game tmora, thanks,
Frenk

name: Khashayar
text:
The hay bales were moved into the barn before the rain and the tarps were tied down. The tractor was fuelled and the mower blades were sharpened for the weekend. The gate on the lower field was rehung.
Thanks,
Khashayar

name: Bettan
text:
The pat test round was completed on both floors and the failed items were quarantined with labels. The extension leads in the kitchen were replaced and the records were uploaded to the portal. The microwave in the break room was withdrawn and a replacement was ordered. The next round is booked for the autumn.
Thanks,
Bettan

name: Ursina Nilakshan
text:
The water butts were topped up and the hoses were coiled in the shed. The greenhouse vents were fixed open for the weekend heat.
Thanks,
Ursina Nilakshan

name: Özde Shriya
text:
The order for the kiln shelves was placed and the confirmation was pinned by the wheel. The clay delivery was checked and two boxes were damp, which was noted on the docket. The glaze buckets were stirred and relabelled.
Thanks,
Özde Shriya

name: Sophia
text:
The petition sheets were collected from both shops and the totals were verified twice. The stall on the market was packed away and the banner was returned to the office. The follow up emails were sent to the councillors and the response log was started. The next street walk is set for the 22nd.
Thanks,
Sophia

name: Guirard
text:
The pool readings were logged and the backwash was run on schedule. The plant room was left tidy and locked.
Thanks,
Guirard

name: Sklabinski Szczepocki Barroso
text:
The raises were submitted to the finance office and the payroll cut off was confirmed. The overtime sheets were signed by the supervisors and scanned to the folder. Two starters were added to the system and their badges were ordered.
Thanks,
Sklabinski Szczepocki Barroso

name: El Tawil
text:
The holiday club figures were tallied and the grant claim was drafted for the funder. The broken bench in the garden was removed and the new one was assembled with help. The craft stock was counted and the order was placed for the new term. The room booking was confirmed through to december.
Thanks,
El Tawil

name: Zarja
text:
The flower beds were weeded and the edges were cut back. The fountain was cleared and the pump was tested.
Thanks,
Zarja

name: Smith
text:
The trench was backfilled and the ducting was rodded through to the cabinet. The jointing was tested and the readings were within tolerance. The reinstatement was photographed for the records.
Thanks,
Smith

name: Lyliane Stinsky
text:
The costumes were returned to the rails and the hire shop confirmed the missing sash. The set was struck after the final show and the flats were stacked in the store. The programme float was balanced and the receipts were handed to the treasurer. The thank you cards were posted to the front of house team.
Thanks,
Lyliane Stinsky

name: Hoffmannová Dartiguepeyrou
text:
The pen trays were refilled and the label printer was reloaded with rolls. The parcel shelf was cleared and the returns were shelved.
Thanks,
Hoffmannová Dartiguepeyrou

name: Rasolofo
text:
The hops order was placed with the supplier and the delivery slot was confirmed for thursday. The keg lines were cleaned and the cellar temperature was checked twice. The tap badges were replaced on the front bar.
Thanks,
Rasolofo
